Requested 17 October; installed and verified 18 October 2026 (Asia/Kolkata).
Project: [LLM Tray](https://github.com/paras-lehana/llm-tray), branch `main`.
Implementation `0a8dc9954a3dc41b846f0f9f8aeb4d4517fb97ab`;
[source prerelease v0.1.5](https://github.com/paras-lehana/llm-tray/releases/tag/v0.1.5).
[Windows CI39058881135](https://github.com/paras-lehana/llm-tray/actions/runs/39058881135) passed.
Public audit: 48 tracked files, zero findings; 69 relative links resolve.

|---|---|---|---|---|
|1|Subtle transparency|have bit transparency on the widget|DONE|Default panel transparency 10%; native alpha verified.|
|2|Delayed appearance|make it appear only when the icon is held for 1 second|DONE|Continuous hover for 1 second; brief passes remain hidden.|

## Business summary

The detail panel is subtly transparent and opens after resting the pointer on
the tray icon for one second. Moving away before that cancels opening. The
Settings dialog exposes both preferences and remains opaque for readability.
Clicking the tray icon still deliberately opens and pins the panel immediately.
"Held" was interpreted and announced as pointer hover, not holding a mouse
button down. This matches the existing hover-panel interaction.

## Point-by-point implementation and evidence

1. **Transparency:** native whole-window alpha, including text; default 10%,
   configurable 0–50%. It is not acrylic blur. Live alpha reads were 255 at 0%,
   230 at 10%, and 191 at 25%. Stronger transparency can reduce legibility on
   busy backgrounds. Settings and the tray icon are unaffected.
2. **Delay:** a shared dwell timer covers both Windows tray mouse-move callbacks
   and the 100 ms hover poll. The old callback opened immediately; removing
   that bypass was necessary. Leaving resets dwell. Click/pin remains immediate.
   At 1000 ms, measured appearances were 1193, 1163 and 1052 ms. At 300 ms,
   appearance was 448 ms. Every run kept brief passes hidden, reset on leave,
   and hid again after leaving. Windows scheduling adds some timing variation.
3. **Settings:** delay accepts 0–10 seconds and stores integer milliseconds;
   transparency accepts integer 0–50. Save preserves the custom data directory
   and reloads the controller. Actual controls saved 0.30 s/25%, 1.00 s/0%, and
   finally 1.00 s/10%. The last values remain installed. Delay is disabled when
   automatic hover is unchecked. Range rejection is implemented; invalid-input
   dialog and keyboard-only operation were not separately exercised this time.

typing, model restart, driver change or cloud inference was performed.

## Owner decisions, pending items and suggestions

No owner decision or requested implementation remains pending. Keep the defaults
initially; adjust **Right-click tray → Settings** if a faster reveal or a more
opaque panel is preferable. Existing remote-chat/reboot follow-ups belong to the
earlier reports and are not resolved by this appearance change.

## Appendix A — Findings and failed probe attempts

Two opening paths existed; changing the timer alone would leave an immediate
mouse-event bypass. Both now obey dwell. Initial private probe attempts failed
because the native icon's accessible name has a script prefix and PowerShell
converted a null FindWindow class argument to an empty string. The application
log showed the panel opening. Fixing those probe assumptions produced the live
measurements above; those attempts are not classified as product regressions.

## Appendix B — Reproduction and private evidence

Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`, then
`python tests/check_tray_status.py --ahk <AutoHotkey64.exe> --output <private.json>`.
Use `tests/measure-drag.ps1` as documented in the testing guide on an idle desktop.
Repeat the native hover/Settings steps there. Production reload used AutoHotkey
`/restart <src/LLMTray.ahk> <existing-data-directory>`; syntax used `/validate`.
Private receipts: `local-data/hover-transparency-status.json`,
`local-data/hover-transparency-drag.json`, and the native probe
`local-data/test-hover-settings.ps1`. Host configs and raw screenshots are ignored.
Windows alpha semantics: [AutoHotkey upstream reference](https://github.com/AutoHotkey/AutoHotkeyDocs/blob/v2/docs/lib/WinSetTransparent.htm).
